answer: Require each agent, in the same 60 second window, to present a fresh TPM quote signed by its own hardware endorsement key from a hardware forge, checked by a verifier panel against the maker certificate. If two identities share one key, or a quote arrives late, the panel revokes both, so one cloned chip cannot feed a river of fakes. One honest agent passes with its own chip, while an attacker faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 distinct TPM chips at $200 each, or $200,000, with each extra fake adding $200. Like a marble dam, it lets honest flow pass while a flood needs real weight behind it.
